title: If You Want My Advice: Status Motives and Audit Consultations About Accounting Estimates

scopes.description: The package supplies a 102-participant survey instrument and a detailed Systat GUI procedure for creating contrariness/precision measures, descriptive statistics, factorial ANOVAs and planned contrasts. It contains no executable program or response dataset. The datasheet states that raw data and the firm identity are protected by a verbal confidentiality agreement. The supplied manual procedure is credited; analysis remains no-runnable-code until software and data access are resolved.

requirements.description: The authors’ response-level survey data for 102 participants, needed to reproduce Table 1 descriptive statistics and Table 2 hypothesis tests. The procedure uses the recommended rate (RATE), acceptable-range endpoints/RANGE_SIZE, randomized status and authority conditions (STATUS/AUTH), and specialized-knowledge measure (KNOW); CONTRARY and PRECISION are generated measures.

routes.location: Authors’ Qualtrics survey responses collected for the U.S. Big Four training-session study; access was governed by a verbal confidentiality agreement.
routes.description: The response data are not in the package. The datasheet explicitly states that raw data and the firm’s identity are protected by a verbal confidentiality agreement and that editors have a firm contact for access. A replicator would need author/firm authorization and must preserve confidentiality. The Systat procedure identifies RATE, STATUS, AUTH and KNOW; RANGE_SIZE is derived from upper/lower responses.
expected_fields: upper and lower acceptable-rate responses needed to derive RANGE_SIZE

software.name: SYSTAT (version unspecified)
software.description: SYSTAT is the prescribed statistical package for GUI-based variable transformations, descriptive statistics, factorial ANOVAs and planned contrasts. A bounded PATH lookup found no systat/SYSTAT command; the supplied PDFs do not specify a version, and the lookup does not establish license or GUI availability.

issues.description: No executable SYSTAT program or script is supplied. The PDFs do provide a substantive manual/GUI procedure with exact variable transformations, menu sequences, model factors and planned contrasts; this procedure is credited as workflow documentation rather than treated as runnable code.

The 102-participant response dataset is absent. The authors state that raw responses and the firm identity are protected by a verbal confidentiality agreement. A questionnaire is not participant-level outcome data; access requires authorization under the existing agreement.
SYSTAT is prescribed, but no version is stated and a bounded PATH lookup found no systat/SYSTAT command. This does not establish that licensed GUI access is unavailable.

evidence.description: Data policy sheet gives collection dates, online Qualtrics host and participant group.
evidence.quote:
The data were collected between June 25, 2014 and June 30, 2014 via an online survey hosted by
Qualtrics. Participants were attendees at three national training sessions for Senior Audit
Managers and Audit Managers of a U.S. Big Four audit firm.

evidence.description: Supplement provides manual Systat instructions, confirms n=102 and names the primary outputs.
evidence.quote:
Experimental participants (n = 102) provided a recommendation to a hypothetical colleague on
the discount rate estimate used by management to calculate the fair value of an asset, and we
held the colleague’s beliefs about the best estimate constant at 13.2%. Participants also provided
a recommendation on the range of acceptable discount rates that management could use, doing
so by providing an upper bound and lower bound of reasonable discount rates.

We provide Systat steps below in bold Calibri.

evidence.description: Supplement gives manual Systat transformations for contrariness and precision.
evidence.quote:
Data>>Transform>>Let>> CONTRARY = RATE – 13.2

Computation of precision:
Data>>Transform>>Let>> PRECISION = ABS(RANGE_SIZE – 7)

evidence.description: Supplement gives GUI steps for Table 1 descriptive statistics by status/knowledge and status/authority.
evidence.quote:
Descriptive Statistics (Table 1, Panel A):

evidence.description: Supplement specifies the 2×2×2 ANOVAs for contrariness and precision and gives results not tabulated in the paper.
evidence.quote:
We first run ANOVAs using SYSTAT for each of our primary dependent measures (contrariness
and precision). We first run a 2 (Motive: status active, status not active) X 2 (Specialized
knowledge: higher, lower) X 2 (Decision authority: high, low) ANOVA with contrariness as the
dependent measure. Second, we run the same ANOVA with precision as the dependent measure.

actions.description: Determine whether the authors or firm can provide an authorized confidential research copy of the 2014 survey responses, or specify the permissible replication access procedure.
steps: Request access through the authors’ established firm contact only under the existing confidentiality agreement and authorized terms; do not disclose the firm identity or redistribute respondent-level data.
Request the permitted response file format, variable/data dictionary, de-identification rules and mapping for RATE, range endpoints, STATUS, AUTH and KNOW.
If access is not possible, ask the authors whether an approved controlled-access copy or certified summary outputs exist; do not synthesize or recollect replacement responses.
validation: Verify the permitted access conditions and confirm that the received data contain the inputs required by the Systat instructions without exposing the firm identity or participant identifiers.

actions.description: Confirm whether a compatible SYSTAT installation and version are available for the documented GUI workflow.
steps: Check the available SYSTAT executable or licensed GUI installation and record its version; the appendix does not specify a required version.
If unavailable, ask the authors for the version used and whether a licensed access route or supported version exists before selecting an alternative implementation.
validation: Use the documented Systat transformations, descriptive-statistics menus, ANOVAs and planned contrasts to verify the software setup only after authorized data access.

actions.description: Follow the supplied Systat GUI procedure after response-data access and software are established; the PDFs provide a manual recipe, not a runnable program.
steps: Import the authorized response data into SYSTAT using an author-confirmed mapping for RATE, upper/lower acceptable-rate responses, STATUS, AUTH and KNOW; derive RANGE_SIZE from the range endpoints.
Create CONTRARY = RATE – 13.2 and PRECISION = ABS(RANGE_SIZE – 7) using the documented Data>>Transform>>Let GUI steps.
Run Table 1 descriptive statistics by STATUS/KNOW and STATUS/AUTH, then the two 2×2×2 ANOVAs for CONTRARY and PRECISION.
Run the specified H1a/H1b/H2a/H2b contrasts and their partial-effect tests; use the stated two-tailed p-values for primary contrasts and one-tailed p-values for partial effects.
validation: Confirm the 102-observation sample and compare Table 1/Table 2 outputs plus the supplemental ANOVA results against the paper; preserve assigned conditions, contrast weights and p-value conventions.

review_notes: The three supplied PDFs include an experimental instrument and an explicit Systat GUI procedure for descriptive statistics, two factorial ANOVAs, planned contrasts and partial-effect tests. These are credited as manual workflow instructions; no executable program is included.

The response data are a separate, required artifact: n=102 participants, collected through a firm-supported Qualtrics survey, with raw data and firm identity protected by a verbal confidentiality agreement. The instrument alone is not analysis data.
No analysis-only scope was added because no response data or executable analysis entry point is supplied. No data were accessed or downloaded, and no author workflow was run.
